__Detailed Explanation__ :- 

__
 
• The line MN is the mirror.
 
• The word [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b22d2e26359aca1b9c47855a2f79f949ffbd3765649117f1032394c5901fba61.png] ends with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/046444e28c30ffb905501a28baf8c93b01f9119d08029e9ba35d5d7a34d23d1a.png] . So, the mirror image will start with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8a1965dda1654dd9bfbc79ea8677ed5870249ce99065dba79050b61f101fb9e.png] → Options 1 is eliminated.
 
• The first letter is [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae502db36c5430808816c5e0fb8ae25f2a025f00a28d1ba31ad61e77e768633b.png] . So, the last letter in the mirror image will be [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/620fc1ba9fa8e3bff088042653b9a46f0953f284a432b2ba60f4788cfa1a674a.png] → Options 4 is eliminated.
 
• The second letter is [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f6b0ffec91012a87eb42fbac3e744a8ebf5c50326a01d76309f4708ac3d767d.png] . So, the third last letter in the mirror image will be [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b08fe496fd70a3e806f139463a7b34180886133f346b3cbcc3cbb2e178f8bf38.png] → Options 3 is eliminated.

Hence, Option 2) is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• In a mirror image **Left changes to right and the right changes to left** where **top and bottom remains the same**.

 
• When placement of mirror not given, by default we will assume it in vertical direction.
 
• The starting letter word will be at last after the mirror image drawn with left changes to right and right changes to left.
